item.title: visualstudio: Organize and revisit tabs with the keyboard
item.description:
Visual Studio adds keyboard shortcuts to reorder document tabs and navigate back to them by their visual position. The update focuses on tab organization and quick revisiting without using the mouse.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for mid-August 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL added customizable keyboard shortcuts for Quick Queries, the Results Grid, and the Query Editor in Visual Studio Code. The changes can be configured directly in the editor.

  • Source: Azure Updates
